episodeTitle.en: The rise of Cursor: The $300M ARR AI tool that engineers can’t stop using | Michael Truell
episodeTitle.zh: Cursor的崛起：这款年营收3亿美元的AR/AI工具让工程师爱不释手 | 迈克尔·特鲁尔

guestBioOfficial.en: *Michael Truell* is the co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, the company behind Cursor—the fastest-growing AI code editor in the world, reaching $300 million in annual recurring revenue just two years after its launch. In this conversation, Michael shares his vision for the future, lessons learned, and advice for preparing for the fast-approaching AI future. *What you’ll learn:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: *迈克尔·特鲁尔*是Anysphere的联合创始人兼CEO，Anysphere是Cursor背后的公司——Cursor是全球增长最快的AI代码编辑器，仅在推出两年后就达到了3亿美元的年营收。在本次对话中，迈克尔将分享他对未来的愿景、经验教训以及为迎接即将到来的AI时代做准备的建议。*你将学到：*

title.en: The rise of Cursor: The $300M ARR AI tool that engineers can’t stop using | Michael Truell
title.zh: Cursor的崛起：这款年营收3亿美元的AR/AI工具让工程师爱不释手 | 迈克尔·特鲁尔

summary.en: Michael describes Cursor's goal of inventing a new way to build software where engineers become "logic designers" specifying intent. He shares the counterintuitive finding that custom models power every magic moment, and that they initially hired too slowly. The episode is a candid founder's view of building the fastest-growing AI developer tool.
summary.zh: 迈克尔描述了 Cursor 的目标：发明一种构建软件的新方式，让工程师变成"逻辑设计者"，只需明确意图。他分享了一个反直觉的发现——每一个魔法时刻背后都有定制模型的支撑，且他们起初招人太慢。本期以坦诚的创始人视角，讲述了如何打造增长最快的 AI 开发者工具。
